style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 112 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, glockenspiel, ukulele and soft handclap hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Who's this baby, small and new?
Peekaboo, peekaboo, I see you!
Guess the baby, one, two, three,
Whose baby is this? Sing with me!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
Tiny and pink, a baby so small,
Now black and white, the cutest of all!
Mama is munching bamboo, look, it's true,
Baby panda, peekaboo!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is it? Who is it?
Peek and guess, then shout it!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Who's this baby, small and new?
Peekaboo, peekaboo, I see you!
Guess the baby, one, two, three,
Whose baby is this? Sing with me!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
Fuzzy ears, a ride up high,
On Mama's back, way up to the sky!
Snowy and white, two cubs in a row,
Koala joey, polar bear cubs, hello!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Peek and hide! (Peekaboo!)
Peek and hide! (Peekaboo!)
Cover your eyes! (One, two, three!)
Open them wide, and what do you see?

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
Orange and stripy, a baby cat,
Next to Mama, how about that!
Close to Mama the whole year through,
Tiger cub, peekaboo!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is it? Who is it?
Peek and guess, then shout it!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Who's this baby, small and new?
Peekaboo, peekaboo, I see you!
We guessed them all, one, two, three,
Whose baby is this? Sing with me!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Peekaboo! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Whose Baby Is This? Sing With Milo
meta.description:
Whose baby is this? Peekaboo! Sing along with Milo the bluebird and guess each baby before Mama comes: a panda cub born pink and tiny, a koala joey that rides on Mama's back, polar bear cubs that often come in twos, and tiger cubs that stay close to Mama for a long time.
A guess-the-baby animal song for kids. Peek, guess and sing along. Ages 2-6.

Facts from the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Library (giant panda, koala and polar bear fact sheets) and Smithsonian's National Zoo (tiger).

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Every fact is checked against trusted sources and every script is reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
